items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer ('[INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe...'). The interviewee, Mike Longo, does not mention any personal or professional relationship with Monk Rowe in the provided text.

ctx.x: Mike was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to be in the home of Mike Longo. I’m going to list a few things and you can edit. I’m looking at your collection of arrangements over here.

Yeah we just arranged it that way man, so it’s much easier. My book got so big, the books were like this thick man, and carrying all that stuff man, and the guys would drop them on the floor. So the bass player did all that. He put each arrangement, everything you see sticking out is what we’re playing Monday night.
